parties: Power Finance Corporation Limited (PFC) / PTC India Limited
headline: PFC files substantial acquisition disclosure in PTC India under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Power Finance Corporation Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE under the SEBI Takeover Regulations, signalling a substantial acquisition in or potential open offer trigger for PTC India Limited. The filing indicates PFC's shareholding has crossed or is approaching a threshold requiring public disclosure under the Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011.
implication: A Reg 31(4) disclosure precedes either an open offer (if 25%+ crossed) or a mandatory cautionary announcement; track whether PFC's ultimate stake triggers a 26% open-offer obligation or remains below, as this governs timing and pricing mechanics under the SEBI Code.
detail: Power Finance Corporation Limited, a government financial institution focused on power sector financing, has made a substantial acquisition disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. PTC India Limited is a central public sector enterprise engaged in power trading and related services. The disclosure filing with NSE indicates PFC's shareholding movement in PTC India has crossed reportable thresholds, mandating immediate public transparency. The precise shareholding percentage, acquisition consideration, and whether an open offer will follow depend on the quantum disclosed in the formal filing.

Central: open offer obligation triggered if acquisition crosses 25% of voting shares or if intent to acquire 25%+ is announced.
